title: Metta Sutta 1
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: Nomon Tim Burnett's talk on the Metta Sutta emphasizes that true loving-kindness is not just about following rules or rituals, but rather about cultivating awareness and recognizing our own motivations. The Buddha taught that practicing metta can be a powerful way to break free from suffering and disease, and it involves examining our actions and thoughts to identify areas where we may be hiding behind justification or excuses. By turning towards self-reflection and improvement, we can develop a positive mindset towards all beings and find greater contentment and peace in life.
topics: Buddhist teachings on virtue and morality
